comment: Template exclusion lists for different test types. 'exclude_list' contains permanent exclusions that apply to all tests. 'main_test_exclude_list' contains games excluded from spoiler-minimal and multiclient tests. 'worldgen_test_exclude_list' contains games excluded from world-generator tests. 'ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list' contains community apworlds excluded from UT fuzz testing due to incompatible rule patterns or apworld bugs. 'requires_javascript_helpers_list' contains games that require JavaScript helpers (excluded from new-rule-types prompts). 'exporter_fully_simplified_list' contains games whose exporters are fully simplified (excluded from helper-export and exporter-simplify prompts). This file is loaded by scripts/lib/test_utils.py.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: A Link Between Worlds.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses compiled Rust extension (albwrandomizer) for game logic. Rules reference self.seed_info.can_traverse() and self.seed_info.can_reach() which evaluate dynamically randomized crack/portal connections (Cracksanity). These methods live in the external library and cannot be exported to static rules - worldgen generates lambdas with 'self' references that fail with NameError.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Against the Storm.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: APWorld issue: Recursive satisfies_recipe() function causes timeouts, and complex can_goal() completion logic makes certain option combinations unbeatable (FillError). Fails during seed generation before UT testing can occur.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Air Delivery.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Python closure bug in apworld causes OR rules to only check the last condition. APWorld bug, not exporter issue.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Ape Escape 3.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses Rulesets class with condense() method that returns closure (lambda state: self.check(state, player)). Exporter cannot trace through closure to extract actual rules stored in self.critical/self.rules lists. Rules export as unknown 'check' helper which defaults to True.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Astalon.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses custom RuleInstance pattern with caching that serializes incorrectly. Exporter captures caching logic instead of actual rules.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Axiom Verge.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses non-standard (state, context) helper signature where context is a LogicContext object containing player and options. Lambda rules use (s, c) parameters mapping to (state, context). Exporter misidentifies these as separate params, creating helpers with inconsistent signatures. Generated worldgen calls like has_trenchcoat(state, player, s, c) pass 4 args to functions expecting 3, causing TypeError.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Balatro.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses complex lambda expressions with list(dict.values()) patterns for item lists. World generator receives dict structure instead of item list, producing broken HasFromList rules with dict keys ('type', 'name', 'args') instead of items.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: ChecksMate.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses custom Material accumulator system. Items add numeric material values to state.prog_items[player]['Material'], and rules use meets_material_expectations() to check accumulated totals. Rule Builder cannot track computed properties.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Chrono Trigger Jets of Time.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Requires YAML generated from external web tool (multiworld.ctjot.com). World validates seed_share_link and raises InvalidYamlException for standard YAML configurations.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Corn Kidz 64.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses custom CK64Rule enum system with data-driven rule evaluation. Incompatible with rule exporter architecture.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: CrossCode.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses custom Condition class system (ItemCondition, QuestCondition, etc.) with c.satisfied() method calls. Exporter serializes condition objects as string representations instead of extracting item requirements. Progressive item replacements in cond_args dict are not processed.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Crystal Project.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses class-level helper methods (can_fight_gran, can_push_ice_block_and_goat, is_area_in_level_range) that combine item checks with game-specific level calculations. Exporter converts these to AST_capability/AST_generic_helper rules, but worldgen generates function calls without defining the functions, causing NameError at runtime.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Digimon World.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses iterative calculate_prosperity helper that accumulates prosperity by simulating digimon recruitment. Cannot export recursive state-tracking logic to Rule Builder format.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Final Fantasy Tactics A2.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: APWorld bug: StartingUnits option allows selecting more than 5 non-special units, but rom.py raises exception during output generation. Fails before UT tracking phase with randomized options.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Fire Emblem Sacred Stones.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Complex finalboss_rule uses for_iter loops, set comprehensions, and closure helpers (level_cap_at_least). World generator cannot convert AST_block with for_iter, falls back to True_() making FinalBoss/Lagdou Ruins always accessible.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Frogmonster.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses functools.partial wrapping lambdas (unexportable) and has bug where 40 bug regions are not registered with multiworld.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Iji.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses module-level constant lists (EventNames.Levels, ItemNames.Sector_Access) with subscript access in rules. Exporter captures AST instead of resolved values. Chained helper functions cause rule expansion to hit size limits, falling back to True_().

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Into the Breach.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Two issues: (1) Requires python-sat package for squad randomization which isn't auto-installed. (2) Rules use Achievement.is_doable_by_tags() but exporter incorrectly assumes 'self' is Location, generating invalid Location.is_doable_by_tags() calls.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses custom getModuleCounts() helper function with nested list counting logic. Exporter cannot translate this to Rule Builder - falls back to True_() making UT think all locations are accessible.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Monster Sanctuary.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses custom AccessCondition class with data-driven rule evaluation. Exporter sees lambda calling rules.has_access() but cannot introspect the AccessCondition tree structure.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Ori and the Will of the Wisps.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses LogicMixin with dynamic resource/combat calculations (wotw_max_resources, wotw_enemies). Exporter hits infinite loop analyzing complex cached state patterns.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Pokemon FireRed and LeafGreen.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Exporter creates AST_capability markers for HM helpers (can_fly, can_surf, etc.) but doesn't export helper definitions. World generator creates undefined function references causing NameError at runtime.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Rabi-Ribi.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Helper complexity exceeds rule analyzer limits (30+ interdependent helpers). Analyzer hits 10000 call limit before full analysis.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Rusted Moss.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Two issues: (1) Character option defines 4 values (fern, maya, ameli, gimmick) but only fern and gimmick are supported - selecting maya or ameli raises ValueError. (2) Rules are created using eval() from dynamically built lambda strings in convert_to_rule(). The exporter cannot analyze these rules because inspect.getfile() returns '<string>' instead of a readable source file. All rules export as 'error' type, causing UT to incorrectly evaluate accessibility.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Sly 2 Band of Thieves.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: APWorld bug: uses generation_is_fake to apply different rules during tracking vs generation. ThiefNet locations skip Episode requirements and Pickpocket locations get wrong region assignments during tracking.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Soul Blazer.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses closure-based data-driven rule pattern with RuleFlag enum dispatch. Cannot reconstruct rules without original closure context.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: System Shock 2.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses custom cyb_mod_count helper that calculates weighted sums of multiple Cyber Module item types. Also uses walrus operator (:=) in lambdas which cannot be analyzed. Would require WeightedSum rule support in worldgen.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses dynamic license dictionaries (pg1_licenses, pg2_licenses) populated during world setup. Rule evaluation iterates over these structures to count items from lower levels. Exported hardcoded dictionaries don't evaluate the same way as server logic.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: The Legend of Zelda - Phantom Hourglass.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Entrance randomization fails frequently with complex option combinations. GER algorithm fails after 10 attempts with mixed pool settings.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: The Sims 4.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: APWorld bug: fill_slot_data() returns keys like 'goal' but generate_early() expects 'goal_value'. Key mismatch causes KeyError during worldgen regeneration.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: ToeJam and Earl.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses custom collect method with point-based rank progression. Rules check pseudo-item 'ranks' which only exists via custom state tracking, not exportable.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: XCOM 2 War of the Chosen.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses custom RuleManager class with power-based access rules. Pattern incompatible with exporter/worldgen pipeline.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Forbidden Memories.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses instance-level state (duelist_unlock_order, final_6_order) set randomly in generate_early() based on options. Access rules call is_card_location_accessible() which depends on this state and cannot be exported to static rules.
